contracts_rationale: No external interface is added or changed: the mission corrects which in-process DRG layer an existing additive-only check reads, and adds one optional field to the internal SynthesisRequest envelope. The CLI's user-facing surface (charter synthesize / resynthesize behaviour) is covered by the regression tests rather than a schema.
purpose_context: Fix #6768: charter resynthesize refuses every activated project directive because the CLI request snapshot mixes the built-in DRG layer with the project's own directives. Separate the layers at the request builder, red-first.
purpose_tldr: Resynthesizing a project's own project directive stops colliding with the built-in layer
